p0.title: Two-Button Notch Lapel Long Coat
p0.descriptionHtml:
A roomy burgundy coat with wide notch lapels and dropped shoulders, cut long to layer over knits.

  • Polyester with a brushed, wool-look texture, black lining
  • Relaxed fit, two-button front, flap hip pockets
  • Below-knee length (about 45–46 in)

Sizes XS–L · Bust 43–48 in

p1.title: Studded Fold-Over Mid-Calf Boots
p1.descriptionHtml:
Slouchy distressed boots with a fold-over shaft and a studded hem, an easy pull-on with jeans.

  • Faux leather upper, textile lining, TPR sole
  • Pull-on, buckle strap at the top, round toe
  • Mid-calf shaft (about 12.5 in), 1.2 in stacked heel

US 5.5–10 (EU 36–42)

p2.title: Triple Buckle Faux Suede Boots
p2.descriptionHtml:
Tall faux suede boots with three buckle straps up the shaft and a burnished toe, made for jeans and skirts.

  • Faux suede upper, faux leather lining, rubber sole
  • Three D-ring buckle straps, almond toe
  • Below-knee shaft (about 14 in), 2.4 in block heel

US 4–11 (EU 34–43)

p3.title: Fringe Faux Suede Ankle Boots
p3.descriptionHtml:
Western-style ankle boots with long fringe down the outer side and a stacked heel, easy over skinny jeans.

  • Faux suede upper, faux leather lining, rubber sole
  • Pull-on, pointed toe with a burnished tip
  • Ankle shaft (about 6 in), 3.2 in stacked block heel

US 4.5–10.5 (EU 34–43)

p4.title: Embroidered Cat Plush Slippers
p4.descriptionHtml:
Fluffy white house slippers with a black cat face on each toe, made for lounging at home.

  • Curly plush upper, cotton lining, TPR sole
  • Backless slip-on, closed round toe
  • Flat cushioned sole

US 6–13 (EU 36/37–44/45, paired sizes)

p5.title: Metal Toe Cap Wedge Mules
p5.descriptionHtml:
Backless mules with a squared metal toe cap and a low wedge, a sharp slip-on with cropped jeans.

  • Smooth faux leather upper, rubber sole
  • Backless slip-on, closed square toe with metal cap
  • Low black wedge heel

US 4–9 (EU 34–40)

p6.title: Floral Print Platform Wedge Slides
p6.descriptionHtml:
A bold paisley-floral wedge under a wide faux suede band, an easy summer slide with denim or linen.

  • Faux suede band, printed wedge, rubber outsole
  • Wide single band, slip-on, open peep toe
  • Platform wedge (about 4 in)

US 4–12 (EU 35–43)

p7.title: Snap Button Fold-Over Knee Boots
p7.descriptionHtml:
Knee-high boots with a wide fold-over cuff and a row of brass snaps, a sleek match for skirts and dresses.

  • Smooth faux leather, faux leather lining, rubber sole
  • Side zip, snap-button trim, small metal charm
  • Knee-high shaft (about 14 in), 2.8 in block heel

US 5–11 (EU 35–43)
